name: Shinno Akikage
source:
A mocking and ridiculing demon. A curse itself. His greatest desire is to defile, to guide people to the wrong path, the demonic and evil one. But most of his deeds are trivial for him; they are only to shorten his time. He is a proper demon, and tries to grant the wish of the one who summoned him as much as he can, sharing it himself.

[spoiler]Therefore, he is trying to grant the darkest desire of Sera Nobuaki, brother of Sera Mizuki—to defile her to the utmost degree for them to fall into the same Hell together.[/spoiler]

As a demon, he does not need to weave his personal dreams to manipulate the world of the collective unconscious, as humans do.
